statuses.label: Blocked at preflight
statuses.meaning: The audit cannot start safely or usefully because required scope, access, tooling, or safety prerequisites are missing.
allowed_when: approved URL or routes are unavailable
required credentials or sandbox boundaries are unavailable
statuses.next_action: Provide missing scope, access, tooling, or approval, then rerun preflight.

statuses.label: Partial static audit
statuses.meaning: Only repository/static/source or supplied static evidence was inspected.
required_evidence: unavailable_layer entries for skipped live/browser/flow layers
statuses.next_action: Approve and provide live/browser prerequisites for a fuller audit.

statuses.label: Partial audit with unavailable layers
statuses.meaning: Some approved layers were completed, but one or more requested layers were unavailable or unsafe.
allowed_when: at least one requested layer is unavailable
forbidden_claims: full live/browser audit completed when browser/live/flow scope was missing
statuses.next_action: Resolve unavailable layers or accept the partial report limitations.

statuses.label: Full live/browser audit completed
statuses.meaning: The declared full scope passed preflight and all required live, browser, and flow evidence was collected for approved layers.
allowed_when: approved routes and flows were checked
required browser_rendered and flow evidence exists
no requested layer needed for full scope remains unavailable
required_evidence: evidence summary tied to all declared full-scope layers
forbidden_claims: auth/payment/admin completion without matching approved evidence
absence of defects as proof of absence outside scope
statuses.next_action: Prioritize fix batches and plan post-fix regression.

statuses.label: Post-fix regression completed
statuses.meaning: Previously reported findings were retested against the approved regression scope with required evidence.
allowed_when: all targeted findings received a retest status
forbidden_claims: new full audit completed unless separately scoped
statuses.next_action: Close fixed findings or create follow-up batches for remaining issues.

statuses.label: Post-fix regression partial
statuses.meaning: Regression retest was run for some findings or layers, but evidence or prerequisites were missing for others.
allowed_when: one or more original findings could not be retested
statuses.next_action: Provide missing retest prerequisites or accept the partial regression limits.
